label: Anniversary of the Dedication of a Church — in the dedicated church (Gregorian Missal)

chants.vernacular_text: How awesome this place is! This is the house of God and the gateway to heaven; and it will be called the courtyard of God. ℣. How lovely is your tabernacle, O Lord of hosts! My soul longs and pines after the courts of the Lord.
This place is the work of God, a mystery surpassing all comprehension, above all reproach. ℣. O God, before whom a choir of Angels stands, answer the prayers of your servants.
